title: 两街样例 D · 转牌到河牌
boundary: 双方范围为手工选择的转牌研究假设，未求解翻前或翻牌。转牌和河牌双方可过牌或下注半池，面对下注只能弃牌或跟注，无加注、无抽水。不是完整单加注底池策略，不匹配或评价来源手牌。

conditions.rangeSource: Manually chosen study ranges at the turn; not solved preflop or flop ranges.
conditions.treeRules: Both players may check or bet 50% pot on turn and river. Facing a bet: fold or call only. No raises or automatic all-ins.

provenance.method: self-generated; independently enumerated analytic benchmark and dual-engine verification
provenance.data: Synthetic lab fixtures; no personal hand histories or third-party strategy archives

report.evScope: Every action EV checked against the exporting engine own average-strategy continuation; conditional posteriors are not required to coincide across different equilibria. No analytic mix solution claimed.

verification.scope: Every action EV checked against the exporting engine own average-strategy continuation; conditional posteriors are not required to coincide across different equilibria. No analytic mix solution claimed.
